title: Gold Bar Salts Cool Mint Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: Cool Mint by Gold Bar is a clean and refreshing blend that delivers a smooth Mint flavour with a crisp, frosty finish from a light touch of Menthol. The mint profile is light and delicately herbal, offering a subtly sweet note on the inhale before giving way to an icy, cooling exhale that leaves a fresh sensation. Made with a nicotine salt formula for a smooth throat hit and fast-acting nicotine relief, this 10ml e-liquid uses a 50/50 VG/PG ratio that’s ideal for MTL (mouth-to-lung) devices. It's a great match for refillable pod vape , vape pens and starter vape kits . Perfect for vapers who prefer minimalist, menthol-style profiles or want a palate-cleansing all-day vape, Cool Mint is a go-to choice in the Gold Bar Nic Salt collection.
